profile.name: Usman Zuhaib
profile.title: Senior Game UI/UX Artist & Graphic Designer
profile.availability: Available for Select Contracts & Full-time Roles
profile.bio: Senior Game UI/UX Artist and Graphic Designer with 12+ years of industry experience crafting production-ready mobile game interfaces, tactile HUDs, stylized game logos, and complete brand identities. Level 2 Seller on Fiverr with an unbroken 5.0 rating across 224 client reviews across the US, Germany, and worldwide.

projects.title: Conscious Ascension — Wellness Casual Game
projects.summary: End-to-end UI/UX architecture for a transformational casual wellness game combining mindfulness progression with polished match-3 mechanics.
projects.challenge: Create a calming, spiritually uplifting visual tone while retaining high-contrast casual puzzle affordances, distinct jewel readability, and a structured multi-pillar wellness progression hub.
projects.solution: Developed an amethyst and luminous violet color palette with metallic gold filigree accents, crystal emerald primary CTAs, clear milestone iconography for each wellness category (Consciousness, Physical, Social, Financial, Mental), and an immersive volcanic puzzle board.
features: Tactile gemstone Play button with radiant depth
Multi-pillar progression screen ('Blasting Shame' mode)
Jewel match-3 grid with high contrast visual feedback
Seamless avatar and character dialogue integration

projects.title: Pet Simulator — Complete UI System
projects.summary: A full-scale UI design system for a casual pet simulation game, covering main menu, breed & accessory wardrobe customization, 7-day retention modal, and in-game task HUD.
projects.challenge: Ensure thumb-zone ergonomics for young and casual players across phone and tablet screens without cluttering the screen during active pet interactions.
projects.solution: Built a refreshing sky-blue and marshmallow-cream UI theme with rounded chunky tactile buttons, clear reward progression chests, and organized accessory tabs (Hats, Collars) with instant preview states.
features: Playful, high-retention Main Menu with clear reward badges
Tabbed wardrobe shop with responsive breed carousel
7-day daily claim system with escalating reward tiers
Contextual interaction HUD with objective tracker & directional controls

projects.title: Gameplay HUDs & In-Game Systems
projects.summary: Production HUD screens spanning military weapon selection, survival inventory crafting grid, match-3 board, action combat controls, and simulation menus.
projects.challenge: Balancing complex data (weapon fire rate, range, damage, inventory capacity) within constrained mobile screen viewports.
projects.solution: Designed segmented attribute comparison meters, modular inventory slots with categorical tabs (clothing, buffs, tools), and thumb-friendly circular touch controls for real-time mobile gameplay.
features: Weapon arsenal screen with attribute stat comparison bars
Full RPG survival inventory & toolbelt grid system
Action hero HUD with dual virtual joysticks & skill triggers
President Simulator & Racing garage launch interfaces

projects.title: Mobile Game Menus & Navigation UX
projects.summary: High-conversion main menu UI systems designed for distinct genres: Anime RPG, Luxury Car Simulator, Goat Comedy Sim, and Spider Action Game.
projects.challenge: Drive day-one player engagement through prominent CTA placement while maintaining natural real-estate for monetization (Starter packs, Remove Ads, VIP passes).
projects.solution: Crafted genre-tailored visual treatments—from neon luxury automotive panels to whimsical comic-style action buttons—optimized for instant comprehension.
features: Anime RPG home dock with Spin Wheel & Daily Chest rewards
Luxury car simulator garage with multi-mode navigation cards
Comic-book action spider menu with 50% discount callout
Whimsical character select interface with dynamic asset frames

projects.title: 2D Game Assets & Inventory Icons
projects.summary: Hand-rendered game inventory items, equipment props, and reward wheels designed for instant silhouette clarity at 64px to 512px resolutions.
projects.challenge: Conveying tangible physical materials (polished gold, refractive glass, glowing neon, carved wood, rusted metal) while maintaining sharp game-engine scaling.
projects.solution: Rendered high-detail textures with emphasized rim lighting, specular highlights, and clean vector bounding paths that pop against dark or light inventory backgrounds.
features: Blood bag elixir flask with liquid volume rendering
Ornate club signet ring with engraved golden filigree
Steampunk chronometer pocket watch with glowing neon indices
Cursed skull padlock, fortune prize wheel, and gothic combat fan

projects.title: Casual & Competitive Game Logos
projects.summary: A curated collection of commercial game logos engineered for high visibility on App Store, Google Play icons, and title screens.
projects.challenge: Creating memorable typography that communicates the game's core hook within half a second of user glance.
projects.solution: Custom dimensional letterforms with genre-specific textures (wooden planks, glossy candy highlights, metallic chrome shields, and speed flames).
features: JoJo's Arcade — Retro 80s arcade machine aesthetic
Blitz Marble Saga — Lustrous wooden placard with floral charms
MHL: Miniatures Hockey League — Collegiate sports shield crest
Countryball RTS, Risky Coin Flip, Math Safari, Football Player

projects.title: Game Splash Screens & Key Art
projects.summary: Full-bleed launch splash screens integrating 2D/3D character renders, atmospheric world environments, and stylized title logos.
projects.challenge: Harmonizing varied rendering styles (casual 3D rendered characters, painted backgrounds, and vector logos) into a unified visual experience.
projects.solution: Composed dynamic scene lighting, atmospheric fog layers, and depth-of-field separation to place title branding at the focal apex.
features: Blitz Marble Saga — Lush cottage garden with cheerful cast
Cosmo Merge — Fantasy champion summon screen with chibi party
Temple Bounce Pinball — Ancient stone temple arcade launch

projects.title: Mascot & Thematic Game Logos
projects.summary: Character-integrated title badges combining character illustration with dynamic typography for action, party, and sandbox gaming.
projects.challenge: Balancing complex character illustrations with legible typography so neither overwhelms the title silhouette.
projects.solution: Unified color palettes and integrated base pedestals that anchor both the mascot characters and the extruded typography.
features: Drunken Bar Fight — Glowing neon sign with brawl action
The Four Horsemen — Western apocalypse character mountain emblem
Hytale Servers — Voxel nature guardian emblem with wooden framing
The Warthogs Brigade — Combat explosive military warthog mascot

projects.challenge: Delivering production-grade vector deliverables (transparent PNG, layered PSD, SVG, and monochrome variants).

experience.description: Managing end-to-end game UI/UX, 2D game graphics, game logos, app icons, and splash screens for clients across the United States, Germany, the UK, and globally. Consistently praised for rapid turnaround and production-ready asset delivery.
Designed high-impact digital campaigns, comprehensive billboard and outdoor print collateral, catalogues, brochures, and promo video reels for premium commercial development.

Led 2D/3D interface art direction across major mobile titles. Designed complete HUDs, navigation flows, icon sheets, and worked directly with Unity developers for seamless hand-off and runtime performance.
Produced marketing creatives, digital advertising campaigns, motion graphic teasers, and print collateral for tech and gaming products.
Crafted mobile game interfaces, vector title logos, and marketing promo materials.
Formative 5 years creating game UI assets, character icons, and high-volume commercial print/typesetting.
